title: Certificates of Deposit: customer-level concentration cap on combined principal
content:
## Scope

This policy governs every opening of a certificate and every deposit into a certificate in the Certificates of Deposit line. It is the only purpose for which a customer's certificates are combined: a customer-level concentration cap.

## Policy clauses

1. **The cap.** The customer's total certificate principal, plus the deposit being made, must not exceed 2500000.00 USD.
2. **How the total is measured.** The customer's total certificate principal is the sum of the principal balances of all of the customer's certificates whose status is not closed, as they stand at close of business on the current date.
3. **Outcome of a breach.** An opening or an add-on that would breach the cap is declined, never reduced.
4. **No combining for pricing.** Balances are never combined for pricing. The jumbo bonus is judged on each certificate's own principal at its term start, and two certificates can never be added together to reach the jumbo threshold.
5. **Compounded interest.** Interest compounded into a certificate may take the total above the cap without any consequence.

## Basis of decision

The total is read from the bank's certificate records for that customer before the opening or deposit is carried out. Every certificate of the customer that is not closed is included, whatever its tier.

## How to work the check

1. Add up the principal balances of the customer's certificates that are not closed.
2. Add the deposit being made.
3. Compare the combined figure with 2500000.00 USD. Equal to the cap is within it; anything more exceeds it.
4. Within the cap, the check is passed. Above the cap, the opening or add-on is declined in full.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical balances)

| Existing total of certificates not closed (USD) | Deposit being made (USD) | Combined (USD) | Outcome of this check |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2400000.00 | 100000.00 | 2500000.00 | Within the cap |
| 2400000.00 | 100000.01 | 2500000.01 | Declined, not reduced to 100000.00 |
| 2500040.00 (above the cap only through compounded interest) | none | 2500040.00 | No consequence for the certificates already held |
| 2500040.00 | 500.00 | 2500540.00 | Declined |

## Wrong reading and correct basis

| Wrong reading | Correct basis |
|---|---|
| A deposit that would breach the cap is accepted up to the cap. | It is declined, never reduced. |
| Two certificates of 60000.00 USD each together reach the jumbo threshold. | Balances are never combined for pricing; each certificate is judged on its own principal at its term start. |
| Interest that lifts the total over the cap must be removed. | Compounded interest may take the total above the cap without any consequence. |
| Closed certificates are part of the total. | Only certificates whose status is not closed are counted. |
